name: Iron Longsword
desc: The first sword every apprentice learns.

name: Steel Longsword

operations.op: Bring the steel to yellow heat

desc: Folded steel, normalised twice. Rewards a steady hand.

name: Steel Bastard Sword
desc: A master's blade. Only an expert can keep the long steel straight.

operations.op: Punch the eye and shape the bit
Dome the boss and band the rim

name: Silver Band
desc: A ring fit for a proposal.

name: Flame Coating
desc: Brushed onto a blade before a hunt: it burns on the strike.

name: Mithril Runeblade
desc: The magic lives in the metal; the markings glow when the blade is drawn.

name: Garnet Ring
desc: Silver set with a garnet; the stone keeps a little of the forge's heat.

operations.op: Bind the stone into the setting

name: Frost Coating
desc: Brushed onto a blade: rime spreads along the edge on the strike. Apply it at the infusion rack.

name: Ranger's Soft Boots
desc: Light and silent: speed matters more than plate for a scout.

name: Emberwarden Longsword

operations.op: Bring the steel to yellow heat
Forge a blade with a socketed guard
Seat the ember rune in the guard
Quench the edge in flame coating

desc: Four crafts in one blade: steel, an ember rune, a flame-quenched edge and a ghost-thread grip.

name: Starsteel Blade
desc: From a forgotten Design found among the barrow-relics.

name: Adamantine Warplate

operations.op: Imprint the ward into the plate

desc: The ward is in the metal itself — not a rune set into it.

name: Hunting Bow
desc: A ranger's first bow. Rangers fight best with one in hand.

name: Yew Longbow
desc: Taller than its archer. Needs a sure hand at the grinding wheel.

name: Steel Cuirass
desc: Folded steel plate: lighter than iron and far harder to dent.

name: Steel Kite Shield

operations.op: Raise the kite and band the rim

desc: A rider's shield; the hardened rim turns a falling blade.

name: Smelt Orichalcum
desc: The red-gold metal of the old sea-kings, made workable only in warded fire.

name: Restore an Old Runestone
desc: Cleaning a weathered tablet yields two sound blanks — and teaches how the old runes were built.

name: Original Rune (your own design)

operations.op: Engrave a rune of your own design
Find the note no one has sung

desc: Not copied from any tablet: a rune the smith designs, the first of its kind.

name: Concord Runestone

operations.op: Tune three runes to one chord

desc: A complex combination: fire, ward and your own rune singing as one.

name: Mithril-plated Cuirass

operations.op: Run the charged mithril into plate
Hammer the mithril onto the cuirass

desc: Steel beneath, charged mithril above; the plates hum when struck.

name: Bearhide Brigandine

operations.op: Rivet the plates beneath the leather

desc: Thick bear leather over hidden iron plates: a hunter's armour.

name: Wyrmleather Boots
desc: Monster leather that shrugs off fire and never wears through.

name: Silverleaf Quintessence
desc: An advanced reagent: binds charged metal to plain steel.

name: Aether Infusion
desc: A magical infusion: brushed onto equipment at the infusion rack, it lends magic for three expeditions.

name: Wyrmfire Coating
desc: An exotic compound: a blade brushed with it burns like dragon's breath.

name: Dragonscale Armour

operations.op: Prepare the scales in wyrm-ash brine
Lace the scales onto wyrm leather

desc: Legendary armour of true dragon scale on a dragon-bone frame. It never leaves the forge below rare.

name: Spin Linen Thread

operations.op: Hackle the flax and spin it on a drop spindle

desc: Combed flax, a drop spindle and patience: plain linen thread.

operations.op: Spin the yarn on a drop spindle

name: Full & Felt Wool

operations.op: Full the fleece in hot soapy water

desc: Hot water, soap and a great deal of trampling: fleece mats into felt.

operations.op: Press linseed from the seed heads and rub it in
Quilt the diamonds around the wool
Spin ethereal thread for the weft
Shoot the ghost-thread through the wool

name: Weave Moonweave

operations.op: Spin silk with ethereal thread by moonlight

desc: Moonwort sap sets the ghost-thread into the silk; the cloth then holds magic like wool holds warmth.

operations.op: Boil the glue out with quicksalt

name: Ward the Cloth

operations.op: Set the aether dust into the thread

desc: A ward rune's pattern copied stitch for stitch into moonweave, fixed with aether dust.

name: Novice's Robe
desc: An apprentice mage's first robe. Plain wool — but cut to let the arms move in a casting.

name: Quilted Gambeson
desc: A fighter's padded coat — worn alone or under mail.

operations.op: Cut the silk on the bias
Run ghost-thread channels through the palms

name: Scholar's Robe
desc: Dyed moonwort-blue; the sigils at the hem steady a caster's ward.

operations.op: Embroider ward sigils from hem to hood
Hang it until it stops moving

name: Archmage's Robe

operations.op: Bind the moonstone into the collar

desc: The finest robe a tailor can make: warded cloth over moonweave. A wizard wearing it shrugs off curses and fire alike.

name: Iron Shortsword
desc: A quick, broad blade — the easiest sword to forge.

name: Steel Shortsword

operations.op: Bring the steel to yellow heat

desc: The same shortsword, in folded steel: keener and longer-lived.

name: Steel Rapier

operations.op: Bring the thin bar to cherry heat

desc: A spring temper lets it bend and come back true — a duellist's weapon.

name: Steel Greatsword

operations.op: Hold the heat along its length

desc: As tall as its bearer. Keeping four feet of steel straight through the quench takes a master's nerve.

operations.op: Punch the eye and shape the bit
Forge the face and the spike

name: Chain Hauberk
desc: Thousands of riveted rings. Tedious work; worth every link.

name: Full Plate Harness
desc: A complete articulated harness — the summit of the armourer's craft.

name: Recurve Bow

operations.op: Back with bear sinew and string it

desc: Steam-bent tips and a sinew back: a longbow's punch from a shorter stave.

name: Silverleaf Warbow

operations.op: Varnish with silverleaf and wrap the grip

desc: An elven-style warbow: the silverleaf varnish keeps it from ever taking a set.
